units.canonical_text: Compare replication and direct access for a hybrid service. With a replica in a shared-services VPC, consumers reach a local endpoint instead of the on-premises service. Account for lag, consistency, and cost.

units.canonical_text: Follow the outbound default route from on premises through the VPN or Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and the egress VPC. The public NAT gateway in a public subnet sends traffic via the internet gateway.
units.speech_text: Follow the outbound default route from on premises through the V P N or Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and the egress V P C. The public nat gateway in a public subnet sends traffic via the internet gateway.

units.canonical_text: Validate the Transit Gateway and subnet route tables in both directions. The return route must know the on-premises prefixes via Transit Gateway. In this zonal layout, use a public NAT in each egress zone and route to the local NAT.

units.canonical_text: Don't substitute a virtual private gateway for Transit Gateway in this on-premises-to-NAT path. Don't substitute a private NAT for the public NAT internet exit. A separate design can use approved customer-provided egress on premises instead.
